tools.name: list_compression_profiles
tools.description: List the three compression presets (light, balanced, maximum) with their exact image quality and max-dimension caps, a note per preset, and the maximum accepted input size. Values are kept in parity with the Compresseur Local web app. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: estimate_compression
tools.description: Detect a file (family, format, size from magic bytes) and estimate the compression gain by ACTUALLY compressing it. tools.name: compress_file
tools.description: Compress a file and return the result as base64. Pass fileBase64 + fileName. Choose EITHER a preset 'level' (light|balanced|maximum, default balanced) OR a 'custom' profile { imageQuality: 1-100, maxDimension?: px, convertFormat?: webp|avif|jpeg } -- supplying both is rejected. Supported families: i
